entries.opinion: Debates on Economic Impacts: Wall Street analysts are debating whether AI will drive a productivity boom or lead to a crisis similar to the Great Depression, citing a potential "Global Intelligence Crisis" due to job displacement.
OpenAI's New Model: OpenAI has closed its Sora app to focus on a new model, "Spud," expected to improve performance significantly.
Anthropic's Claude Model: Anthropic is preparing a Claude model aimed at testing AI reasoning effectively.
Nvidia's Claim: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that AGI has been achieved.
AI Product Features: n8n announced upcoming AI product features during its March livestream, including data handling integrations.
AI-generated Artist: Ne-Yo expressed confusion over a record label signing an AI-generated artist, highlighting industry tensions.
